inputs.text:
Folks, it is crystal clear that the radical erosion of our foundational family values has now reached the heart of Fianna Fáil. Dublin South-West TD John Lahart is leading a push against traditional standards by whining about inheritance tax exemption thresholds, claiming the current system is ‘wholly unfair’ and discriminatory against those who chose not to have children. This is just the logical endpoint of his party colleagues pushing to review how inheritance tax is applied across different family structures.

Let’s be entirely honest about what is happening here. For generations, passing down the fruits of a lifetime of personal responsibility to your children has been the absolute bedrock of cultural continuity and family stability. It is the core reward for the sacred duty of parenthood and building a future for the next generation. But the modern, rootless agenda is desperate to dismantle that, demanding that the state re-engineer society so that childless individuals get the exact same privileges as those who sacrifice to raise families. 

Mr. Lahart himself completely gave away the game when he stated, ‘At [...]’ and if we allow these elites to tear down these vital distinctions, we destroy the very incentives that keep a healthy, traditional society standing. We must stand firm for authority, tradition, and the families who sacrifice to secure a lasting legacy.
